content_data.meeting_title: Regulatory Compliance and Cross-Border Operations Review
agenda_items: Discussion of new FERC interstate transmission compliance requirements
Review of updated EPA emissions standards and impact on refinery operations
Timeline review for ISO 14001 recertification across North American facilities
Budget allocation for environmental monitoring systems upgrade
key_decisions: Approved $4.2M capital investment for emissions monitoring technology at three Gulf Coast refineries to meet revised standards within 18 months
Authorized engagement of external legal counsel specializing in Canadian energy regulations to expedite pipeline approval process
Deferred decision on Mexico facility expansion pending clarity on bilateral energy trade agreements
action_items: CIO to present cybersecurity infrastructure upgrade proposal and vendor recommendations within 45 days
General Counsel to provide comprehensive risk assessment on cross-border regulatory exposure within 3 weeks
